review: Existing validated NodeStatisticsSource remains the single map/card/table source; frequency math and source fetching unchanged. StatisticsDialog becomes retained StatisticsPanel in ToolPage. Actual compact-map selection is supplied explicitly; settings reopen preserves the manual query. Stable source/query avoids repeated rebuild, and source reorder preserves selected node type/column/reading. Manual query clears the old mapped caption. Identical updates clear loading status; failures preserve previous data. Unsupported map distances do not clamp. All Compact.present consumers now use ToolPage; obsolete generic owner-dialog route removed, including the remaining hover card consumer. Qt-documented deferred column geometry is followed by one coalesced next-loop row resize. Player-facing map and hover labels simplified; original detailed pool conditions stay expandable. Existing game identity/freshness, note unsaved guard, cache validation and send protection remain.
